data.name: Hanamanth
data.gender_notes: Hanamanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hanamanth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Hana' which means 'grace' and 'Mantha' which means 'man'. This name signifies the divine grace bestowed upon an individual by the gods. The name Hanamanth carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hanamanth usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hanamanth carries significant cultural importance in Hindu tradition. It is a testament to the deep reverence and belief in the power of grace and divine intervention in one's life. The name is also a reflection of Hindu philosophy, which emphasizes the interconnectedness of all beings and the role of the gods in shaping our destinies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hanamanth carries the deepest meaning. It is a reminder that ultimately, our lives are not in our hands alone, but in the hands of the divine. The name inspires devotion, humility, and a deep sense of surrender to the will of the universe. It serves as a constant reminder to seek the grace of the gods in times of need and to remain steadfast in the belief that even in the face of adversity, divine intervention can bring about positive change.
